environment: Windows host, Docker Linux/amd64, isolated owned Compose instance, Chromium

source.head: 17468376565ec06480e92362240cc30d8edcad2d
source.note: HEAD is the build baseline; the tested uncommitted source tree is fixed by the source digest, not claimed as an already committed future revision.

results.name: generate owned local PKI without changing OS trust
prepare persistent configuration with separate credentials and HTTPS database verification
start built read-only non-root images and explicit least-privilege provisioning
repeat provisioning without resetting credentials or generating data
deployment preflight rejects untrusted release signatures and changed runtime images
real Console login via TLS discovery, code, PKCE, nonce, JWKS and server session
distinct Admin origin is not authenticated by Console cookie; independent login lands safely
API restart preserves server-side browser session
database restart preserves identities and sessions with the same volume and TLS key
actual protected backup is readable by pg_restore and release switching preserves volume and secrets
nonce tampering rejects login; no forged session is issued
logout invalidates persistent session and mobile page remains meaningful

limitations: Actual signed HTTPS protocol IdP simulator; not an external identity-provider certification.
Chromium accepts the fixture CA only inside its test context. API and PostgreSQL continue certificate verification; no OS trust store changed.
Same-release stopped switch and restart verified; not arbitrary cross-version schema rollback or a production RPO/RTO claim.
No target production host, public DNS, real payment, supplier license or human G4/G5 approval was provided.
